proposed_comments.title: Rebase and complete the current PowerToys integration
proposed_comments.body:
### Rebase and complete the current PowerToys integration

**Severity:** `high`

The branch currently conflicts with `main`, and several integration points in this snapshot no longer match the repository. Please rebase and update ClipPing for the current solution and Settings architecture, including `.slnx`/Runner dependencies, settings navigation and serialization, Quick Access and GPO mappings, OOBE, installer upgrade shutdown, signing, privacy and attribution notices, developer documentation, and a settings fuzz target. Please also update the PR checklist and Validation Steps after the current x64 Debug chain builds.

proposed_comments.title: Harden the runtime lifecycle and persisted settings path
proposed_comments.body:
### Harden the runtime lifecycle and persisted settings path

**Severity:** `high`

Before merge, please make the background process resilient to detached/duplicate instances and rapid disable/re-enable: take ownership of an existing instance, wait for graceful or forced termination, and close all process/event handles. Route overlay work through the UI dispatcher, preserve existing extended window styles, recreate the overlay after virtual-desktop changes, and handle recreated settings files. Normalize null, malformed color, and unknown overlay values during load/reload with bounded retries, then add regression coverage for defaults, GPO refresh, Quick Access notifications, navigation, serialization, and malformed settings. These paths otherwise allow enabled-with-no-process, wrong-thread, stale-settings, Alt+Tab, and invisible-overlay failures.

test_instructions: Copy text, images, and files; verify both top-edge and border overlays and a custom color on multiple DPI-scaled monitors.
Switch virtual desktops and copy again; verify the overlay appears on the active desktop and does not appear in Alt+Tab or the taskbar.
Start ClipPing detached, then enable, disable, and rapidly re-enable the module; verify one owned process remains and the enabled state never points to a missing process.
Delete/recreate or corrupt the ClipPing settings file; verify bounded reload retries, safe red/top defaults, and recovery without a crash or repeated hot-path warnings.
Toggle ClipPing in Settings and Quick Access and exercise the enabled-state GPO; verify both surfaces refresh immediately and policy locking/unlocking is correct.
